summary: Iter 198 — 'Parler en direct' (AI support chat + escalation + admin inbox) fully validated end-to-end. BACKEND pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter198_live_support.py — 8/8 pass (7.6s): unauth blocked (401); POST /api/support/message creates thread and returns user+ai messages (GPT-4o-mini, FR); GET /api/support/me returns {thread, messages} with _id stripped; POST /api/support/escalate sets status='escalated'; POST /message after escalate returns only [user] (no AI reply) and unread_admin increments; admin GET /support/admin/threads?status=escalated lists the escalated thread; GET /support/admin/threads/{id} returns full history; empty admin reply 400; POST /admin/reply adds 'agent' message visible to client; POST /admin/close sets status='closed' so client's /support/me returns thread=null; non-admin gets 401/403 on admin endpoints; merchant role can chat (AI replies). FRONTEND Playwright covering all 4 flows: CLIENT (/livechat) — sends message → AI reply renders under 'Assistant IA' label; clicks 'Parler à un conseiller' → escalated-banner visible; ADMIN (/admin/live-support) — admin-live-support page renders, escalated thread listed via support-thread-{id}, opening it loads conversation, admin-reply-input + admin-reply-send sends agent reply, sidebar shows 'Parler en direct'; E2E — re-logged-in client sees agent reply 'Marc du support' with 'Conseiller' label within polling window (5s); close-thread-btn closes the conversation; MERCHANT (/merchant/live-support) — merchant-livesupport renders with sidebar 'Parler en direct', sending message returns AI reply. Backend pytest leaves no escalated/open thread (closed by test) — merchant 'ai' thread left open is harmless (admin default filter is 'escalated').
critical_code_review_comments: routes/support.py:_ai_reply degrades gracefully when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing or emergentintegrations import fails — returns a polite FR fallback inviting escalation. Good.

Escalate endpoint inserts a 'system' message with sender='ai' (the 'Je transfère…' notice). Functionally correct but mixing 'ai' sender for a system event slightly muddles message provenance; consider sender='system' if you later want UI to distinguish it. Non-blocking.

Admin reply forces status='escalated' on every reply (even on a previously-closed thread). Minor: a closed thread, if it surfaces via 'all' filter, can be re-opened by replying. Consider rejecting reply if status=='closed' or document this behaviour.
_get_active_thread filters out closed threads — correct so client gets a fresh thread post-close.
Admin endpoints correctly call require_role(['admin']) — non-admin gets 401/403 (verified).
MongoDB _id is consistently projected out ({_id: 0}) on all reads — good.
SupportChatPanel.jsx polls /api/support/me every 5s — fine for the demo scale; for production at scale consider websockets/SSE. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on client + admin + e2e + merchant UI flows
